desc: Implement a helper `minFlips(L)` that returns flips needed to make all runs <= L: handle L == 1 by counting mismatches to patterns "0101..." and "1010..."; for L >= 2, iterate runs and sum len // (L+1).
Binary search L over [1, n] for the smallest value with minFlips(L) <= numOps.

Verify against the three provided examples and edge cases: numOps = 0 (answer = longest existing run), s already alternating (answer 1), n = 1 (answer 1), all-same string with enough flips (answer 1).
Random brute-force validation for small n (try all flip subsets up to numOps) to confirm correctness, especially the L=1 special case (e.g., s="0110" needs 2 flips for L=1).
